Package ui

Class CashierView

java.lang.Object
ui.CashierView
public class CashierView extends Object
Order entry: customize panel on the left, menu tabs in the middle, current order on the right.

    • buildOrderPanel

      private javafx.scene.control.TitledPane buildOrderPanel()
      Builds and returns the current order summary panel. Each line has - and + buttons so the quantity can be changed right from the order list, and the totals update as soon as anything changes.
      Returns:
      the TitledPane representing the order panel

    • changeQuantity

      private void changeQuantity(OrderLine line, int delta)
      Adds delta to a line's quantity. Going below 1 removes the line from the order.
      Parameters:
      line - the order line to change
      delta - how much to add (negative to subtract)

    • refund

      private void refund()
      Opens a dialog to process a refund for a specific order number.
      Throws:
      NumberFormatException - if the entered order identifier is not a valid integer

    • pay

      private void pay()
      Takes payment for the current order. With the customer display open, the customer chooses the tip and payment method there and the order is locked until they pay or the cashier cancels. Otherwise the cashier fills in the payment dialog.

    • saveOrder

      private int saveOrder(double amount, PaymentResult result)
      Saves the current order with its payment and clears it for the next customer.
      Parameters:
      amount - the subtotal before tax and tip
      result - the tip and payment method
      Returns:
      the new order's number

    • receipt

      private static String receipt(int orderId, PaymentResult result)
      Builds the one-line summary of a paid order shown to the cashier.
      Parameters:
      orderId - the saved order's number
      result - what was paid
      Returns:
      for example "Order #1042 paid with Cash: $12.71 (tip $1.55)"

    • endCheckout

      private void endCheckout(String message)
      Unlocks the order after the customer pays or checkout is canceled.
      Parameters:
      message - what to show under the totals, or "" for nothing

    • toggleCustomerDisplay

      private void toggleCustomerDisplay()
      Opens or closes the customer display from the button under the order. While it's open, Finish Order sends checkout to the customer instead of opening the payment dialog.

    • customerDisplayClosed

      private void customerDisplayClosed()
      Runs when the customer display closes, however it was closed. An unpaid checkout is canceled.
